request.description: A native pixel art modular sprite kit for a whimsical mobile fantasy snow mountain fortress, 128x128 transparent canvas. Six fully separated individual objects in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid, each confined within its 40x60 slot with empty transparent margins. Top row: LEFT a sturdy narrow weathered timber upright with snowy top, iron bracket and short side arm; CENTER a hanging warm amber iron lantern on a short chain; RIGHT a burgundy red hanging banner on a wooden rod with simple ivory white stag-antler emblem. Bottom row: LEFT chunky blue-gray rock outcrop capped by piled white snow; CENTER three tall faceted pale cyan ice crystals emerging from a snowy rock base; RIGHT a short snowy timber rope fence post. Front-facing flat 2D sidescroller view. Strong clean dark contours #0a0d11, connected broad shading clusters, simple controlled top-left light, subdued brown timber and blue-gray iron, cold snow shadows. Chunky charming pixels, carefully drawn 1 pixel details, restrained palette, no anti-aliasing or gradients, no ground plane, no background, no text, no scene, no characters. Keep each object distinct, whole, and separated for cutting into modular sprites. Professional readable game asset quality, quiet materials with small bright lantern and crystal accents.
